# StreamDek Mobile — 11 August 2026

## New

**Your playlists now follow your account**
M3U, M3U8 and Xtream playlists were saved on this phone and nowhere else. They now
belong to your profile: add one here and it appears in the web portal and on StreamDek
TV, and anything added there appears here. Playlists already on your phone are uploaded
once, the first time this version runs — matched on their address, so adding the same
playlist from a second device joins the entry that already exists rather than creating a
duplicate. Channels are still fetched and read on the device; only the address travels.


**Use your own IntroDB key**
Skip Intro, Skip Recap and Skip Ending look up their timings on IntroDB. Settings →
Playback → Skip and Autoplay now takes a key of your own, so the lookups count against
your allowance instead of the access built into StreamDek. Leave it empty and nothing
changes.


**Settings rebuilt around what each setting does**
The pages were grouped by history rather than by subject: the player lived under
Streams, gestures under Playback Automation, and Live TV settings were spread across
three pages. Settings now opens on Account, Playback, Appearance, Sources, Connections
and About, with each page holding one subject — Player, Skip and Autoplay, Subtitles,
Streams and Quality, Downloads, and so on. Nothing was removed. Searching still finds
the old names, so "torrent" reaches Peer-to-Peer, "seek" reaches Player, and "live
progress bar" reaches Live TV.


**Swipe to seek, and hold to speed up**
Drag left or right across the video to scrub and let go to jump there. Press and hold
anywhere on the video to play faster until you release, at a speed you choose. Both are
under Settings → Playback → Player, in Gestures.


**Usenet sources play**
A usenet result carries an NZB and a list of news servers rather than a link, so these
appeared in the source list but could never start. StreamDek now fetches the NZB, pulls
the articles from the server the source names, and decodes and reassembles them on the
device. Playback starts on the first part rather than waiting for the whole file, and
seeking moves the download ahead instead of working through everything in between. All
of it happens on your phone — no part of a usenet stream passes through a StreamDek
server. Posts needing par2 repair, or packed into RAR archives, are not supported yet.


Improved
---

**The Home spotlight no longer shows the synopsis**
At a glance the artwork and title carry the title; the paragraph underneath was rarely
read and took room from the artwork. StreamDek TV made the same change, so both now open
the same way. Turn it back on under Settings → Appearance → Home Screen.


**One place to enter your MDBList key**
The key could be typed on the Ratings page or on the MDBList page, and only the MDBList
page checked it — so a mistyped key saved on Ratings looked accepted and quietly returned
no ratings. Ratings now shows the connection state and sends you to the MDBList page,
which verifies the key before saving it.


**Manage Profiles is reachable from the Settings home**
Creating a profile, setting a PIN or deleting one could only be reached through the
profile picker. There is now a Manage Profiles row under Account.


**Downloads reads like every other settings page**
The Allow Downloads switch sat loose on the Settings home while everything around it was
a link. It now lives on the Downloads page with what it controls.


Fixed
---

**Add-on error cards no longer appear as results**
AIOStreams publishes a placeholder whenever a source behind it fails. These were listed
as though they were streams, so a title could look as if it had found something when it
had found nothing playable. They are now left out.
